podcast.body: Released on November 18, 2003, this fifth album marked a significant departure for the band. After individual side projects by Tom and Travis, the band members were growing up and sought a more mature sound. The recording sessions were extensive, involved trying out numerous instruments and recording techniques, and featured Robert Smith of The Cure on guest vocals. It was more experimental, darker, and incorporated new sounds. "This fifth album, the self-titled one that was released on November 18, 2003, had a different sound."
